products.title: Dark wide-leg denim jeans
products.description: These women's baggy jeans are made from soft, stretchy, wear-resistant cotton fabric that is lightweight, moisture-wicking, and comfortable for all-day wear. Designed with a high-waisted, wide-leg Y2K-inspired fit, they pair effortlessly with T-shirts, sweaters, cardigans, and jackets, making them suitable for every season. Perfect for school, work, parties, vacations, dates, or everyday wear, these versatile jeans combine style and comfort. Please refer to the size chart before ordering, and wash with cold water by hand or machine for best results.
products.editorNote: A bold wide-leg shape that works with cropped knits, fitted tees, fitted shirts, and clean sneakers or boots.
